title: b7z9.5.4: Node — ACK processing and retransmit for SCHC fragmentation sessions
description: Child of project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.5. Receive loop classifies SCHC ACK / ACK-REQ frames and feeds FragmentSender::handle_ack_frame; retransmit timers expire via the send/receive loop; ack-on-error recovery per the schc crate profile. Depends on b7z9.5.2 (RX classification) and b7z9.5.3 (sender state). Loopback tests: lost-tile recovery, ACK bitmap handling.
